subject: [AMBER] Native Contact Analysis in cpptraj input script

messages.author: Priyasha Majee
messages.body:
Dear All,
I am doing analysis in cpptraj. I want to do native contacts analysis.
for that, i have prepared the following input file:
parm nowaterWT.prmtop
trajin nowaterWT.nc 1 last 500
nativecontacts name NC1 :100-200&!.H=\
writecontacts native_contactsWT.dat\
resout resoutWT.dat\
noimage distance 5.0\
byresidue out all-residueWT.dat mindist maxdist\
map mapout gnu\
contactpdb contactspdbWT.pdb\
series seriesout nativecontactsseriesWT.dat
savenonnative seriesnnout nnn-WT.dat
run
i get the following error:
CPPTRAJ: Trajectory Analysis. V4.14.0 (AmberTools V19.11)
___  ___  ___  ___

Please help me out with this.
Thanks in Advance
Priyasha
